curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As an eerie glow pulls citizens toward an unstoppable alien menace, can a trapped group discover a way to endure the siege?
curatedMovie.description: Strange lights descend on Los Angeles, drawing people outdoors as an extraterrestrial force begins consuming the population. Trapped amidst the chaos, a small band of survivors fights for their lives.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and suspenseful sci-fi action with apocalyptic stakes, ideal for an exciting, engaged group watch.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Colin and Greg Strause, this sci-fi thriller moves at a relentless, fast clip, delivering high-stakes invasion spectacle built around pure survival adrenaline.
